title: Seat comfort, rear space, and seat features
summary: Feedback about seats centers on appreciation for ventilated seats and front-seat accessory mounts, alongside complaints about rear seat folding and rear-seat space or usability, while many excerpts are too fragmentary or descriptive to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise ventilated seats and useful mounts on the back of the front seats for hangers or tablet holders.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on dissatisfaction with how the rear seats fold and with space or practicality around the rear seating area.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention rear-seat room, seat appearance, accessory requests, and seat-adjustment references without enough context to classify sentiment reliably.

limitations: Many sampled excerpts are short labels, service-style notes, or ambiguous statements that do not provide enough context for reliable sentiment classification.
The topic mixes distinct seat subtopics, including front-seat features, rear-seat space, folding behavior, accessories, and climate requests, so the sample is not a single tightly focused issue.
Examples are limited for some complaint themes, so the summary should not be treated as representative of all seat-related feedback.
